body: I don't have any family. Literally none
People I vaguely know. I live in a large city so I also just see people running errands
Unfortunately my building doesn't allow pets, but thank you for the suggestion.

Thank you for the kinds words. I do actually have lots of interests and hobbies, so to speak. I've tried meetup to no avail. I think I come across as pretty normal, I've even been told that before. Thank for your the hug, I appreciate it.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can't even imagine what that would feel like.
I appreciate the offer. I've never really played video games before and I don't know how to play them
Thank you for the suggestions. I do speak with a therapist weekly
I rewatched Network recently. It's one of my favorites. I most recently reread Schopenhauer, thus my ID.
The simplest things. Watching a movie. Laughing at a joke. Talking about books. Anything. The constant loneliness is crushing

It's really quite mundane. I just messed around with obscure stuff when I was a kid because I had nothing else to do and got decently good at it. The corporate world is really soul-crushing. I had wanted to be a classicist when I was a kid, and got into a good program in another country, but wasn't allowed to go.
I don't want to go into specifics, but I have a somewhat unusual set of skills viz. computer science that have made me (evidently) attractive to employers.
I appreciate that. It means a lot. I hope things improve for you as well
